entities.name: Kijirō Nambu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kijirō Nambu  was a Japanese firearms designer and career officer in the Imperial Japanese Army. He founded the Nambu Arms Manufacturing Company, a major manufacturer of Japanese military firearms during the period. He was awarded the Order of the Sacred Treasure in 1914. Because of his prolific firearms designs, Nambu has been described as the "John Browning of Japan."

entities.summary: Kijirō Nambu  was a Japanese firearms designer and career officer in the Imperial Japanese Army. He founded the Nambu Arms Manufacturing Company, a major manufacturer of Japanese military firearms during the period. He was awarded the Order of the Sacred Treasure in 1914. Because of his prolific firearms designs, Nambu has been described as the "John Browning of Japan."
